items.title: Flocked Tree with Red Ornaments and Bokeh
items.prompt:
An exquisite, printable Christmas card design, frontal view, aspect ratio 1:1.4.

The composition features a close-up of a heavily flocked Christmas tree on the left side. The branches are covered in thick, soft white artificial snow. The tree is elegantly decorated with a mix of ornaments: glossy metallic red baubles, textured glittery red baubles, and smooth, matte white baubles. A few green pine needles and a small cluster of red berries are visible near the bottom.

The background on the right is a sophisticated, dark gray monochrome, filled with a beautiful bokeh effect of soft, out-of-focus white lights, creating a dreamy and festive atmosphere. The image uses a selective color style, where only the red ornaments and text are in vibrant color, while the rest of the scene is in shades of white and gray.

Over the bokeh background on the right, the greeting {argument name="greeting" default="Merry Christmas"} is written in an elegant, flowing red script font, perfectly matching the color of the ornaments. The overall aesthetic is modern, clean, and sophisticated.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Luxurious Burgundy and Gold Botanical Tree
items.prompt:
A printable, exquisitely detailed Christmas greeting card design, aspect ratio 1:1.4.

The illustration features a stylized Christmas tree arrangement against a rich, festive background. On the left side of the card is a wide vertical band of textured gold foil. The tree itself is a lush composition of winter botanicals, including deep green holly leaves, teal-colored foliage, and delicate pine needles detailed with shimmering gold line work and texture. Bright red berries are scattered throughout the greenery. The arrangement sits in a textured gold pot.

The main background is a deep burgundy red with a subtle texture, adorned with faint, darker snowflake patterns. A delicate flurry of white specks, like falling snow, covers the entire scene. At the bottom, the text '{argument name="text" default="Season's Greetings"}' is written in an elegant, light gold cursive font.

The overall style is classic, luxurious, and highly detailed. Flat 2D graphic illustration.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Luxurious Black and Gold Abstract Tree
items.prompt:
An exquisite, printable Christmas greeting card design, featuring a modern, minimalist aesthetic on a solid, deep black background.

The central focus is an abstract Christmas tree, artfully rendered with loose, calligraphic strokes made of sparkling faux gold glitter and shimmering confetti.

Beneath the tree, the greeting '{argument name="greeting" default="Merry Christmas"}' is written in elegant, thin gold lettering. The word "MERRY" is in a simple, small, uppercase font, and "Christmas" is in a beautiful, flowing script.

The overall design is high-contrast, luxurious, and clean. High resolution, flat graphic design. --ar 1:1.4
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Corporate Typography Tree
items.prompt:
An exquisite, printable corporate holiday card design with a modern, minimalist aesthetic, presented as a flat graphic with a 1:1.4 aspect ratio.

The background is a solid, deep burgundy red with a subtle matte paper texture.

The central focus is a Christmas tree shape created entirely from typography. The phrase '{argument name="Holiday Greeting" default="May Your Days Be Merry and Bright"}' is rendered in a whimsical, white, hand-lettered calligraphy script. The words are artfully arranged to form the tree's silhouette, with "Your," "Merry," and "Bright" being the most prominent.

Small white stars are scattered within and around the text, enhancing the festive tree shape and adding a touch of sparkle. A single, larger white star sits at the very top as a tree topper.

Below the tree, centered at the bottom, is custom text in a clean, simple, white sans-serif font. It reads: '{argument name="Closing" default="from all of us at,"}' on the first line, and '{argument name="Company Name" default="GRIFFON FINANCE CORPORATION"}' on the second line.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Rustic Hand-Drawn Pine Wreath
items.prompt:
A beautiful printable Christmas and New Year greeting card in a charming, hand-drawn rustic illustration style, high resolution, 1:1.4 aspect ratio.

The design is set against a light cream-colored background with a subtle, speckled paper texture giving it a vintage feel. A festive wreath made of sketchy, hand-drawn pine branches in shades of dark green forms an open circular frame. Woven through the pine branches are elegant white ribbons with thin red outlines, and small, solid red holly berries are scattered amongst the leaves. A large, beautifully tied bow, matching the ribbon style, sits at the bottom center of the composition.

In the center of the wreath, the greeting {argument name="Main Greeting" default="Merry Christmas"} is written in a large, flowing red cursive script. Below this, the word {argument name="Connector" default="AND"} is centered between two thin red horizontal lines in a clean, uppercase sans-serif font. The final message, {argument name="Secondary Greeting" default="HAPPY NEW YEAR!"}, is written below in the same red sans-serif font.

The overall aesthetic is clean, festive, and heartwarming with a flat, graphic illustration quality.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Retro 1950s Christmas City Street
items.prompt:
A vibrant and exquisite 1950s retro Christmas card illustration in a flat graphic style. The scene depicts a bustling city street at night, with a light dusting of snow on the ground and gentle snowflakes falling. In the background, a row of mid-century and Art Deco buildings glow with colorful, festive neon signs for a '{argument name="Department Store Name" default="Kringle's"} DEPARTMENT STORE', '{argument name="Diner Name" default="Starlight DINER"}', a theater named '{argument name="Theater Name" default="COMET"}', and a shop called '{argument name="Fashion Store Name" default="Hollys"}'. The department store features a large display window with a decorated white Christmas tree surrounded by toys.

The sidewalks are filled with cheerful shoppers in 1950s winter fashion, carrying gifts and shopping bags. In the upper right sky, a large, glowing full moon shines as Santa's sleigh and reindeer fly past in silhouette.

In the foreground, a classic red and cream 1950s station wagon is parked, its interior filled with colorfully wrapped presents. A couple with two small black dogs walks on the sidewalk, holding more gifts. Further down the street, a yellow taxi carries a Christmas tree on its roof. On the right, a red A-frame sign on the sidewalk displays the message '{argument name="Holiday Message" default="Happy HOLIDAYS"}'. The overall atmosphere is festive and nostalgic, with a rich color palette of deep blues, reds, and greens. Printable quality, aspect ratio 1:1.4.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Victorian Santa on Rooftop Balcony
items.prompt:
A vintage Victorian Christmas card illustration featuring a cheerful Santa Claus on a snowy rooftop balcony at night, overlooking a quaint village. Santa is a portly figure with a full white beard and rosy cheeks, dressed in a classic red suit with white fur trim and a black belt. He is blowing a small brass horn and holding a dark wooden walking stick.

A large wicker basket filled with old-fashioned toys, including a small fir tree and a drum, is visible on his back. To the left, part of a large clock tower face with Roman numerals is seen. Santa stands behind an ornate, snow-covered stone balustrade with intricate gothic carvings.

In the background, the cozy village has steep, snow-covered roofs and windows glowing with warm light. The night sky is a deep blue, with soft, heavy snowfall covering the entire scene.

At the top, the greeting {argument name="text" default="Merry Christmas"} is written in a decorative, vintage font, appearing as if formed from snow on a dark eave.

The artwork has the textured feel of a classic chromolithograph print on aged paper, with a rich, slightly faded color palette. The style is nostalgic, festive, and magical.

Exquisite and highly detailed, printable quality, aspect ratio 1:1.4.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Layered Papercraft Cutout Tree
items.prompt:
An exquisite, printable Christmas greeting card design in a layered papercraft and die-cut style, presented in a 1:1.4 aspect ratio. The card features a vibrant red textured paper background with faint, soft-edged light red polka dots.

In the center, a stylized Christmas tree is created as a cutout, revealing different green patterned layers beneath. The tree is composed of four stacked sections, topped with a simple yellow star. From top to bottom, the green sections have different designs: solid light green, medium green with white polka dots, medium green with white dashed stitch lines, and darker green with white wavy lines.

Flanking the middle of the tree are two intricate, white, die-cut snowflakes with a subtle drop shadow. The top and bottom borders of the card are adorned with elegant white paper cutout swirls and filigree, creating a decorative frame.

At the bottom, the text {argument name="text" default="Merry Christmas"} is written in a beautiful white script font, also designed with a cutout effect and a slight shadow to give it depth. The entire composition is clean and graphic, with a charming handmade feel due to the layered paper effect.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Cute Doodle Reindeer Face
items.prompt:
A beautiful, printable Christmas greeting card design in a flat, frontal view. The illustration is in a charming hand-drawn doodle style, featuring thick black outlines and a simple, festive color palette.

Centered in the bottom half is the head of a cute cartoon reindeer with simple antlers and a prominent, bright red nose.
Above the reindeer, the words {argument name="text" default="Merry Christmas"} are written in a friendly, red, handwritten script.
The background is an off-white paper texture with a subtle pattern of thin, diagonal beige stripes.

The overall aesthetic is clean, whimsical, and perfect for a holiday card. High quality 2D vector art with a matte finish. --ar 1:1.4
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Vintage Sledding Children
items.prompt:
A beautiful and printable vintage Christmas postcard in a classic chromolithograph illustration style, aspect ratio 1:1.4.

The scene features two joyful children, a boy and a girl, sledding together down a gentle, snow-covered hill. The boy in front, wearing a red pointed hat and a white patterned shirt, steers a traditional wooden sled with ornate, curved runners. The blonde girl sits behind him, wearing a white dotted bonnet, a red jacket, and a purple skirt, smiling warmly as she holds on.

The background shows a quaint winter forest with snow-dusted trees. The foreground includes the corner of a rustic log structure on the right and soft snow with sled tracks. The entire illustration has a nostalgic, warm feel, with delicate gold foil accents on the children's clothing and the sled.

At the bottom, elegant gold cursive lettering reads {argument name='text' default='Fröhliche Weihnachten'}.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Humorous Santa on North Pole Sign
items.prompt:
A high-resolution, printable, humorous Christmas greeting card design in a 1:1.4 aspect ratio, created in a flat digital illustration style.

The scene features a cheeky cartoon Santa Claus playfully clinging to a red-and-white striped candy cane pole, which stands in a snowy landscape. Santa is smiling and winking, wearing his classic red suit, hat, and black boots. At the top of the pole is a small wooden sign pointing left with the words "NORTH POLE".

The background is a vibrant teal-blue sky with soft, falling snow particles creating a wintery feel. The ground is covered in simple mounds of white snow with light blue shading.

On the left side of the card, text is arranged vertically. At the top, in a simple black sans-serif font, are the words "{argument name="top text" default="I got"}". Below this, the phrase "{argument name="colorful phrase" default="Ho Ho Ho's"}" is written in a playful, bold font with each word in a different color. Underneath, the final part of the phrase, "{argument name="bottom text" default="In Different Area Codes"}", is stacked vertically in the same black font as the top line.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Retro Mid-Century Lights and Garland
items.prompt:
A beautiful, printable retro holiday greeting card illustration with a 1:1.4 aspect ratio. The design features a flat, solid cream-colored background.

Across the top hangs a festive green holly garland with red berries and a large red bow tied in the center. A string of colorful, vintage-style Christmas lights in red, golden yellow, and green dangles from the garland on a thin black wire.

In the center of the card, the text {argument name="main text" default="HAPPY HOLIDAYS"} is displayed in a bold, classic red serif font, decorated with whimsical teal mid-century modern style starbursts on either side.

Beneath this, the message {argument name="sub-text" default="WE WISH YOU AND THE WORLD PEACE AND LOVE THIS HOLIDAY SEASON."} is written in a simple, clean black sans-serif font.

The overall aesthetic is clean, graphic, and charmingly nostalgic, in a flat vector art style.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Vintage Shushing Santa at Night
items.prompt:
A beautiful, printable vintage Christmas card illustration in a classic, painterly style, aspect ratio 1:1.4.

The scene depicts a magical winter night in a quaint village. A jolly Santa Claus is the central figure, dressed in his traditional red suit with white fur trim, shushing with a finger to his lips. He carries a large green sack filled with presents over his shoulder.

To his left, a cheerful snowman with a carrot nose, a red scarf, and a small hat stands beside an ornate, old-fashioned lamppost. The lamppost is lit, casting a warm, golden glow on the snow, and is decorated with a festive wreath and a large red bow. A small, wrapped gift sits in the snow at the base of the snowman.

Heavy, soft snowflakes fall from a deep blue night sky, blanketing the scene and the village houses in the background, whose windows glow warmly. The overall atmosphere is peaceful, nostalgic, and full of holiday spirit.

In the upper right corner, the text is written in an elegant, white cursive script: {argument name="Text" default="Happy Holidays"}.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Whimsical Woodland Animal Gathering
items.prompt:
An exquisite and printable watercolor illustration for a holiday greeting card, aspect ratio 1:1.4. The style is charming, whimsical, and storybook-like, with a soft, gentle color palette.

The scene depicts a cheerful gathering of forest animals in a snowy winter woodland during a light snowfall. In the center, a beautifully decorated Christmas tree is adorned with red ornaments, snowflake cutouts, cookie stars, pinecones, and a rustic twig star on top.

A large black bear, wearing a Santa hat and a cozy red scarf, stands on its hind legs admiring the tree. A small bear cub next to it, wearing a green scarf, waves joyfully. To the left, a graceful doe wears a holly wreath with a large red and white striped bow, and a tiny, cute white owl with a red scarf sits on her back. In front of them, a small fawn with a Santa hat lies peacefully in the snow.

To the right, another large black bear with a Santa hat and a festive evergreen wreath around its neck walks forward, carrying a small cub in a red knitted hat on its back. The foreground features an adorable raccoon in a Santa hat holding a snowflake, a squirrel, a quail, and several bright red cardinals.

The background consists of soft, muted evergreen and bare birch trees, where more birds, including owls in festive scarves and cardinals, are perched on the branches. The entire scene has a soft watercolor texture on paper.

In the top left corner, the text '{argument name="text" default="Happy Holidays!"}' is written in an elegant, flowing red cursive script.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Magical Glowing Forest and Snowman
items.prompt:
A beautiful, printable holiday greeting card design, aspect ratio 1:1.4.

A magical winter night scene in a deep, snowy forest. On the left, a charming snowman with a carrot nose, wearing a black top hat and a colorful plaid scarf, gazes towards a brightly lit Christmas tree on the right. The evergreen tree is laden with snow and adorned with vibrant, glowing multicolor Christmas lights that cast a warm, colorful glow on the surrounding soft, powdery snow. A luminous, multi-pointed star shines brightly at the top of the tree.

The atmosphere is serene and enchanting, with a deep blue and purple color palette. The background of snow-covered pines is softly out of focus. In the upper left, the text '{argument name="Text" default="Happy Holidays"}' is written in an elegant, flowing white script. The entire image is enclosed by a thick navy blue border with a delicate white inner line.

Photorealistic with a whimsical touch, high detail, magical glow.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Mid-Century Modern Homecoming
items.prompt:
A beautiful and printable mid-century modern Christmas card illustration, depicting a heartwarming, snowy nighttime village scene from a high angle.

A family arrives home for the holidays in a classic 1950s retro red station wagon, its headlights casting a warm glow on the snow. People are joyfully greeting each other outside a cozy, yellow two-story house with a snow-blanketed roof and a smoking red brick chimney. The house's windows are cheerfully lit from within, adorned with small wreaths.

To the left, a large outdoor Christmas tree is decorated with colorful ornaments and a glowing star on top, surrounded by smaller snow-dusted evergreens. In the distance, under a deep blue starry sky, are other simple houses on a snowy hill. The foreground is framed by the dark, silhouetted branches of bare winter trees where a few small birds are perched.

Elegant white cursive script in the sky reads {argument name="Text" default="Season's Greetings"}.

The style is stylized and nostalgic, with the clean, graphic feel of a vintage gouache or screen print. The color palette is rich with deep blues, vibrant reds, and warm yellows.

--ar 1:1.4
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Modern Scandinavian Folk Art Reindeer
items.prompt:
A whimsical and exquisite Christmas card illustration in a modern Scandinavian folk art style, frontal view.

The design features a highly stylized reindeer on a plain, off-white background. The reindeer's body is a canvas of intricate and colorful patterns in dark blue, red, orange, and teal. A small, charming folk art bird is perched on the reindeer's back. The reindeer's large, dark blue antlers are whimsically decorated with colorful hanging Christmas baubles and ornaments.

To the right of the reindeer stands a simple, geometric teal Christmas tree, adorned with a simple pattern.

At the bottom of the card, the greeting {argument name="text" default="MERRY CHRISTMAS"} is written in a playful, hand-drawn sans-serif font, with each letter in a different vibrant color.

The overall aesthetic is a flat vector illustration with bold colors and a subtle screen print texture, making it perfect for printing.

Exquisite, printable, aspect ratio 1:1.4.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Art Deco Burgundy and Gold Card
items.prompt:
A beautifully detailed Christmas greeting card illustration in a flat graphic, Art Deco style. The composition is vertical with a 1:1.4 aspect ratio, perfect for printing.

The background is a solid, rich burgundy red. A prominent golden arch frames the upper half of the card, decorated with small, scattered golden stars and sparkles. At the apex of the arch is a larger, radiant golden star.

Five vintage-style Christmas ornaments in shades of dark green, cream, and gold hang from the arch by delicate golden threads with bows. Each ornament has a unique shape and intricate geometric pattern.

Below the hanging ornaments, the greeting {argument name="Greeting" default="Merry Christmas"} is written in an elegant, flowing golden script.

The entire design is enclosed by a sophisticated double golden line border. The inner border features a repeating pattern of 'x's and dots, with a simple heart outline centered at the bottom. Two golden bells with radiating lines are placed in the top corners of the card. The overall aesthetic is clean, festive, and sophisticated with a metallic gold finish on all line work and text.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Vintage Winter Scene with Snowman
items.prompt:
A vintage Christmas postcard illustration in a classic chromolithograph print style, featuring a heartwarming winter scene, aspect ratio 1:1.4.

The entire image is enclosed by a decorative, continuous border of green holly leaves and bright red berries on a slightly aged, off-white paper background.

The central scene depicts a snowy landscape under a muted teal-blue sky. In the middle, a friendly, lumpy snowman wears a dark, wide-brimmed hat adorned with a holly sprig and has a pipe in its mouth. A young child in a red coat and blue cap playfully peeks from behind the left side of the snowman, holding a snowball.

In the right foreground, a young boy wearing a brown jacket with a white sailor collar, blue knickers, a vibrant red beret with a pom-pom, and tall brown boots holds a small shovel, looking towards the viewer.

Bare, delicate winter trees stand in the background. A small wicker basket filled with holly rests on the snow in the lower left foreground.

At the top left, elegant cursive script reads {argument name="greeting" default="A Merry Christmas"} in a golden-red hue.

The overall aesthetic is flat, 2D, charming, and nostalgic, with the stippled texture and color palette of a beautiful, high-quality, printable retro greeting card.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Victorian Children and Snowman
items.prompt:
A vintage Victorian Christmas card illustration in a beautiful chromolithograph style, printable and exquisite, aspect ratio 1:1.4.

The charming winter scene features two children and a snowman in a snowy garden. In the foreground, a child wearing a red polka-dot coat with a white fur-lined hood bends over a small wooden sled, tucking in a doll wrapped in a green blanket. Standing nearby is a young girl with curly brown hair, dressed in a light blue coat with white fur trim and gold details, and a matching ruffled bonnet. She holds a small evergreen sapling.

Between them stands a friendly snowman with button eyes, wearing a brown pot for a hat and a gold belt. The background shows a snowy landscape with a large, bare tree trunk on the left and a snow-capped stone gatepost with an ornate iron gate on the right.

The entire illustration has a soft, stippled texture and a nostalgic, aged paper feel. The color palette is muted with reds, blues, and browns. There are subtle, shimmering gold glitter accents on the tree trunk, clothing details, and the snowman's belt. At the bottom, elegant, cursive gold leaf lettering reads {argument name='text' default='A Merry Christmas'}.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Minimalist Botanical Ink and Watercolor
items.prompt:
A printable, exquisite Christmas greeting card design, presented in a frontal view with a 1:1.4 aspect ratio.

The style is a beautiful, clean blend of minimalist watercolor and fine ink line art on a textured white watercolor paper background. A crisp white banner runs horizontally across the middle, neatly framed by a delicate, light-blue watercolor line above and below. Centered within this banner is the text '{argument name="greeting" default="Merry Christmas"}' in an elegant, modern black calligraphy script.

Above and below the banner, a light and airy pattern of winter botanicals is scattered. This pattern features delicate branches with leaves in two styles: some are simple black ink outlines, while others are filled with soft, translucent watercolor washes of dusty blue, teal, and periwinkle. Small, vibrant red watercolor dots represent berries, clustered together and accented by tiny, artistic red splatters, giving it a charming handmade quality.

Flat 2D illustration, high resolution, perfect for printing.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Vintage Chromolithograph Kittens
items.prompt:
An exquisite, printable vintage Christmas postcard illustration in a beautiful turn-of-the-century chromolithograph style. The image features a heartwarming scene of six adorable, fluffy kittens gathered around a large white ceramic bowl of milk on a soft, textured, warm off-white background.

One brown tabby kitten stands on the left. At the top of the bowl, two more tabby kittens lean over to drink, one with a small yellow ribbon. A dark, almost black kitten with a tiny green ribbon stands on its hind legs to reach the milk. On the right, a tortoiseshell kitten with a big red bow clings to the side of the bowl. At the bottom, a small tabby kitten sits on the floor, watching the others.

The overall feel is charming and nostalgic, with detailed, painterly fur and gentle shadows. In the top left corner, elegant red cursive script reads {argument name="text" default="A Happy Christmas"}. --ar 1:1.4
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Modern Pointillism Christmas Tree
items.prompt:
A minimalist and modern Christmas greeting card design, presented in a flat, front-on view.

In the center of the card, on a clean, solid white background, is a stylized Christmas tree. The tree is created using a pointillism technique, composed of small, colorful dots in a festive palette of red, sage green, and dark blue. The dots are arranged to form a simple triangular shape. At the base of the tree is a short, solid dark blue trunk.

The overall style is clean, graphic, and elegant. This is a high-resolution vector illustration, perfect for printing.

The design should fill the frame, created at a 1:1.4 aspect ratio.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Watercolor Polar Bear Mother and Cub
items.prompt:
A beautiful, printable watercolor greeting card illustration, aspect ratio 1:1.4.
The scene features a heartwarming moment between a mother polar bear and her cub, sitting together on a bed of clean white snow that covers the bottom of the frame.
The bears are rendered in a painterly style with visible brushstrokes, using shades of off-white, cream, and soft grey to create texture and depth.
The background is a deep, moody night sky with a rich watercolor wash of emerald green, dark teal, and black.
Scattered across the sky are small, elegant, stylized stars in shimmering gold foil.
In the upper left, the words '{argument name="greeting" default="merry christmas"}' are written in a delicate, handwritten gold foil script.
Flat 2D illustration, charming and artistic, high detail.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Kawaii Pink Pig and Gingerbread Doodle
items.prompt:
A beautiful, printable, high-quality kawaii Christmas illustration in a 1:1.4 aspect ratio.

The scene is a whimsical winter wonderland in a cute doodle art style with bold outlines and a soft pastel color palette. In the center is a detailed gingerbread house covered in snowy white icing. A giant, adorable pink pig in a Santa suit and hat looms playfully behind the house.

In the snowy foreground, two happy gingerbread men in Santa hats are sitting on large, pink-frosted donuts. A cute snowman with a Santa hat and blue scarf smiles on the left. The snow is decorated with candy canes, a large swirl lollipop, and colorful sprinkles. To the right stands a cheerful Christmas tree.

The light blue sky is filled with falling snow, and a gingerbread Santa Claus is flying across in his sleigh, pulled by a gingerbread reindeer. The entire scene is bustling with tiny, round pink pigs and cute brown bears, found on the roof, climbing candy canes, and even falling from Santa's sleigh along with little gifts. All characters have simple, joyful expressions and rosy cheeks, creating a festive and heartwarming atmosphere.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Polar Bears under Aurora Borealis
items.prompt:
A whimsical and enchanting Christmas card illustration of a mother polar bear and her cub. They are standing on a small, light blue ice floe in the lower-left, gazing up in wonder at the magical night sky.

The sky is a beautiful, painterly gradient of deep navy blue, vibrant turquoise, and a soft purple aurora borealis effect. It's filled with a large, radiant golden Star of Bethlehem in the upper right, surrounded by smaller golden stars and delicate, white snowflake-like stars.

The ocean is a dark, deep blue with horizontal brushstrokes and shimmering reflections of starlight at the bottom.

In the upper left corner, the text {argument name="greeting text" default="Merry Christmas"} is written in an elegant, golden cursive script.

The artwork is in a charming watercolor and gouache style, with visible textures and a heartwarming feel. High detail, beautiful, print-ready. Aspect ratio 1:1.4.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Trio of Gingerbread Cookies
items.prompt:
A charming and humorous Christmas card design in a flat vector illustration style. The scene features three cute gingerbread men cookies standing in a horizontal row against a plain white background.

From left to right: the first gingerbread cookie is a girl, smiling happily with an open mouth, decorated with two pink heart buttons and a sprig of holly on her head. The middle gingerbread man wears a red Santa hat and a matching red scarf, with green buttons and a cheerful smile. The third gingerbread man has a shocked expression with a round open mouth, wearing a red and green bowtie, with a large bite taken out of his leg and crumbs falling.

Below the cookies, the text reads {argument name='text' default='HO HO OH ...'} in a simple, handwritten font.

The design is clean, with bold outlines and a festive color palette of brown, red, green, and pink. Exquisite and printable quality, 1:1.4 aspect ratio.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Luxurious Black and Gold Corporate Card
items.prompt:
An elegant and luxurious Christmas and New Year greeting card design, presented as a flat graphic, high resolution and perfect for printing. The design features a deep black background scattered with fine golden glitter dust and soft bokeh lights.

Large, intricate snowflakes with a sparkling gold glitter texture cascade down from the top of the card, creating a beautiful, festive border. In the center, the text "merry" is rendered in a flowing, handwritten gold glitter script, followed by "CHRISTMAS" in a bold, embossed gold serif font. Below this, the phrase "and Happy New Year." is written in a delicate, thin gold script.

Positioned towards the bottom is a horizontal rectangular block with a brushed gold foil finish. Inside this block, feature the custom text: {argument name="Company Name" default="Crestline ENTERTAINMENT, INC."} in a simple black font.

The overall aesthetic is sophisticated and celebratory, with a strong contrast between the black and the glittering gold. Aspect ratio 1:1.4.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Watercolor Santa with Copy Space
items.prompt:
A beautiful watercolor Christmas illustration, in a whimsical and heartwarming style.
On the right side of the frame, a jolly cartoon Santa Claus waves cheerfully, standing in soft snow. Next to him is a tall, festive Christmas tree adorned with glowing lights, colorful baubles, and a shining star on top. Several wrapped gifts in red paper with gold bows sit at the base of the tree.

The background is a dreamy, abstract watercolor wash, transitioning from a deep teal-blue at the top to a warm, golden glow that radiates from behind the tree. A large, soft, light-colored area is left on the upper left, providing ample copy space.

Delicate snowflakes and soft white dots gently fall throughout the scene, creating a magical, snowy winter atmosphere. The entire artwork has a visible paper texture with soft, blended colors.

High resolution, intricate details, printable festive art. --ar 10:14
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Minimalist Watercolor Festive Fox
items.prompt:
An exquisite, printable Christmas greeting card design, aspect ratio 1:1.4.

The card features a beautiful watercolor illustration of a red fox against a clean, solid white background. The fox is the central focus, depicted from the chest up in a seated position, with its head turned slightly to the side, casting a gentle, downward gaze.
